output.title: What hours can we schedule a member callback?
output.draft_text:
Question: What hours can we schedule a callback?

Answer: Schedule member callbacks on weekdays (Monday through Friday) between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern. (Source: approved unit U-KNOWN-FACT.)

When scheduling:
- Convert the member's preferred time to Eastern and confirm it falls within the 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern window. Members in other time zones may need an earlier or later local time.
- Do not schedule callbacks on weekends.
- Holidays: [whether callbacks can be scheduled on company-observed holidays, and the list of observed holidays].
- Latest start time: [whether a callback may be booked to start right up to 6:00 p.m. Eastern or must end by then, and any required buffer].
- If the member is only available outside these hours: [approved alternative, for example escalation path, voicemail, or secure message option].
- How to book: [system or tool used to schedule the callback and any required fields].
